Team colours

Left teamShirt Trim Right teamShirt Trim

Players wear their country's flag or their club's colours (the clubs are made up), and colours change instantly. The shirt/trim pickers (or "Custom colours…") set your own. The left team kicks off first. If both pick the same country, the right team gets a white ring.

Power-ups

OrangeWhite

Every player on a team gets that team's power-up. It applies when a match starts (R restarts). Pick "None" for Haxball's exact physics.

Controls

Click a key, then press the new one. Esc cancels. A key already in use is swapped. The fixed keys can't be used. Auto curl and Swap curl keys are in ⚙ Settings (Your curl).

Your curl

Auto curl
Swap curl keys

Curl: hold up or down as you shoot; it still goes where you aim. Auto curl: your shots curl into the corner by themselves. Swap curl keys: up bends it down and down bends it up (a free kick's left and right swap too). Each player's own; online, P1 is you. The computer always curls a bit.

How to play

Keys

P1
P2
P3
AllEsc or M menu · P pause · R restart · F fullscreen · + − zoom (Follow all, Auto, 1×–3×) · G go in goal and back out, the computer taking your man (P2 .; change it in Controls) · 1–8 emotes (two on one keyboard: P1 1–5, P2 6–0) · online Enter or T chat

Change them in Controls. In fullscreen inside Claude the browser takes Esc to leave fullscreen: M opens the menu and stays fullscreen.

Play

  • Kick fires as soon as the ball's in reach: hold it as you run in (you run a little slower while you hold it).
  • Power shot (when it's on in ⚙ Settings): keep the ball at your feet until the ring round it fills and it glows; your next kick is a power shot. Learn it: Practice → Power shot lesson.
  • After a goal, press your keys again to move.
  • Tap kick twice quickly: call for the ball. Your computer teammates pass it to you as soon as it's safe (your keeper holds it a moment for you). When one of theirs has it near your goal, it sends your computer keeper out at him.
  • Emotes show over your player (EZ, Skill issue 💀 and more); online everyone sees them.

Curl

  • Hold up or down as you shoot: it swings out the other side and bends that way, back to where you aimed.
  • How much: Curve in ⚙ Settings, where Auto curl and Swap curl keys are too (each player's own).
  • Learn it: Practice → Curl lesson.

Free kicks

  • ↑↓ aim · ←→ curl · hold kick for power.
  • The dots show where it goes.
  • The keeper reads where you aim: aim one way, curl it the other.

Slide tackles

  • Get the ball first. Take the man in your own area: penalty.

On a phone

  • Stick moves, KICK kicks, SLIDE slides. Hold the stick across your shot to curl it.

Welcome to Pitch Brawl

First time?

A short tutorial shows you every control: moving, kicking, curling, calling for the ball, slide tackles, free kicks, emotes and the other keys, and what extrapolation means online. About four minutes, and you can skip any part.
